The '''Killik–Imperial summit''' took place around [[3641 BBY]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] to establish a formal diplomatic relations between the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Arranged by a former [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] member turned [[Oroboro]] [[Joiner]] [[Vector Hyllus]], it represented the Imperial side with [[Falner Oeth]] from the Diplomatic Service and the hives with Hyllis and [[Daizanna]] of the [[Iesei]]. Falner Oeth attempted to sabotage the proceedings, setting off an explosion that killed Daizanna and using it to deliver a speech on the inferiority of Killiks. Nevertheless, Vector managed to persuade the Killiks to sign a [[Killik–Imperial treaty]], opening the borders for trade and establishing protocols for military and diplomatic contact.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Killik-Imperial summit is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during Vector Hyllus companion storyline.
